articles.title: Power returns in Cole County; Osage County sees hundreds without power
articles.description: COLUMBIA, Mo. (KMIZ) Nearly 1,300 Ameren customers were without power in Cole County on Thursday. The outage began at 7:14 p.m., after a strong cell entered the area. There were 1,264 customers without power at 7:54 p.m. Power was mostly restored before 9:50 p.m. Ameren's map then showed Osage County having 537 customers without power
